articles.title: OpenBSD 8.0 released
articles.summary: Hot on the heels of Wine being ported to OpenBSD , we now have the release of OpenBSD 8.0 . It adds hibernate support for arm64, switches the sparc64 toolchain to LLVM, and updates the DRM graphics drivers to Linux 6.18.53, which also adds support for Intel Arc A-Series (DG2/Alchemist) graphics cards.

articles.title: OpenXR gets a cross-platform Spatial Windowing API
articles.summary: What's happened? The OpenXR Working Group within Khronos just released the Spatial Containers extensions to bring a cross-platform windowing API to XR. What are they?

articles.title: Claude Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch
articles.summary: Anthropic's Claude independently designed protein binders targeting deadly scorpion neurotoxins. Out of more than 318,000 designs, 211 were tested in the lab. Seventeen met the criteria, and the two strongest bind extremely tightly to Cn2, a toxin from a Mexican scorpion.

articles.title: A Stereo Vision Board For Hardware Hackers
articles.summary: If you’re new to experimenting with stereo vision, you might find this to be a useful platform for getting started. Design files are on GitHub for the curious.

articles.title: Here’s everything new in Android 17 QPR3 Beta 2 [Gallery]
articles.summary: Over the coming hours, we’ll dive into all of Android 17 QPR3 Beta 2’s new features and every single change. (The newest updates will be at the top of this list.

articles.title: RTS game Theatre of War: Rearmed set for release on December 9
articles.summary: Bringing together all the classic Theatre of War RTS games into one upgraded package, Theatre of War: Rearmed set for release on December 9th. Read the full article on GamingOnLinux .

articles.title: Deepseek open-sources the inference engine that powers its fastest and cheapest AI model
articles.summary: Deepseek has open-sourced DeepInfer, its internal inference framework, under the Apache License 2.0. Inference is how a trained AI model handles requests and generates responses.

articles.title: Claude Code v2.1.305
articles.summary: Fixed every request failing on Vertex, Bedrock and other providers when the endpoint or a gateway rejects tool search, and behind gateways with ToolSearch disallowed or left out of --tools (a 2.1.304 regression): Claude Code now retries without it.

articles.title: SuperSwitch HD – SNES HDMI Mod
articles.summary: Stanislav Parhomovich, the creator of the Sega Genesis / Mega Drive HDMI mod called the MegaSwitch HD has just released an HDMI mod for the Super Nintendo / Super Famicom.

articles.title: 5 GHz Drone Video, With An ESP32
articles.summary: It’s good to see these projects appear, especially as this one’s 5 GHz and shows those chips work too with the hack. We’d be interested to know whether the latency of the SDR affects its usability though.

articles.title: Android 17 QPR3 Beta 2 for Pixel rolling out with 21 fixes
articles.summary: You can report issues via the Android Beta Feedback app on Pixel devices. Access it from the application drawer or Quick Settings to file bugs in Google’s issue tracker.

articles.title: iOS 27.2 adds new features in six iPhone apps, here’s what’s coming
articles.summary: Every major streaming service has its own profiles feature, letting users on the same account keep their viewing history and recommendations separate. Apple TV has long offered such a feature in tvOS, but now with iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2 it’s coming to iPhone and iPad too.

articles.title: Here's another 15 demos worth checking out in Steam Next Fest - October 2026 edition
articles.summary: Steam Next Fest - October 2026 edition is sadly rammed full of very clear low-effort slop games, they're everywhere. It's pretty east to spot them too thanks to the AI warning browser plugin , along with certain types of Steam images looking the same.

articles.title: Mistral AI launches Voxtral 3, a full voice agent stack that listens, thinks, and talks in real time
articles.summary: Mistral AI has launched Voxtral 3, a new family of language models built for real-time voice agents. The system includes a speech-to-text model (Voxtral Small Transcribe 3), a text-to-speech model (Voxtral Mini TTS 3), and a voice agent SDK based on LiveKit.

articles.title: Google upgrading Gemini for Android Auto with Personal Intelligence
articles.summary: On the privacy front, Personal Intelligence is opt-in, though it will come to Android Auto automatically if you enabled it for the Gemini app on your phone.

articles.title: Play with friends with the Social Multiplayer Games Collection from Digiphile
articles.summary: Digiphile (former Humble Bundler staff) just launched their new Social Multiplayer Games Collection . This bundle supports the International Medical Corps charity with a portion of proceeds going to it.

articles.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 is much better with legacy programming languages such as COBOL and Fortran
articles.summary: OpenAI improved its latest models for low-resource programming languages like COBOL, Fortran, and Visual Basic. On the new MultiLangBench, GPT-6 Astra hits an 87.4 percent test pass rate across 20 languages, up from about 38 percent for GPT-5.6 Terra.

articles.title: How 3 Java Champions are using GitHub Copilot for increased productivity
articles.summary: To learn how experienced developers strike that balance, we spoke with three Java Champions, all with over a decade of experience in using Java. They shared concrete examples of using GitHub Copilot in production and open source, along with the practices they use to turn AI-generated output into reliable software.

articles.title: Plants can speak using electricity, so this startup built an AI model to decipher their language
articles.summary: The founders believe their model could one day lead to a tool that would let people “speak” to plants. “We’re listening more than we’re speaking, but listening’s the first step,” said Mast, co-founder and CEO of Electric Plant.

articles.title: Bulk migrate branch protections to rulesets for a repository
articles.summary: You can now convert all branch protection rules of a repository to rulesets in a single action. This is an extension of the ability to convert a single branch protection rule to a ruleset that we released previously, now allowing for at-scale conversions.

articles.title: PS5 Linux hack now supports (some) newer firmware versions
articles.summary: New PS5 Linux hack pLinux5-NG supports newer firmware, allowing Linux and Steam games to run on Sony's console. But not for long, welp. You're reading PS5 Linux hack now supports (some) newer firmware versions , a blog post from OMG!

articles.title: Give Nautilus file manager the ‘Computer’ view it lacks
articles.summary: The Nautilus file manager is great for browsing your files and folders, but it lacks a dedicated way to see all your drives a how much space is left on each – but you can add one.
